answer: Each epoch, 5 randomly drawn established graders run a lantern audit: they compare every new key's answer timing, wording embeddings and funding source. Keys whose trait kernel overlaps another's above 0.85 are merged into one cluster sharing a single reward, so 20 sybils earn 1 share, not 20, a 20x cut to the farm's return at the same running cost. Weakness: honest teammates on one cloud host can be merged. Fix: flagged keys first carry an umber warning tag for 3 epochs and split back out if each passes its own live interview with 3 other graders.
